llms.body:
# PopCash

> PopCash is a self-serve popunder advertising network for advertisers who want to buy popunder traffic and publishers who want to monetize their websites. Live since 2012, serving global inventory across 240+ GEOs on CPM and CPC pricing models.

PopCash specializes in the popunder ad format — one of the highest-volume, lowest-friction formats in performance advertising. Advertisers get worldwide reach with granular targeting; publishers get high-fillrate monetization with daily payouts from $10.

## Getting started

- [Sign up (free)](https://popcash.net/register): Create an advertiser or publisher account. $5 minimum deposit for advertisers, $10 minimum payout for publishers.
- [For Advertisers](https://popcash.net/advertisers): Buy popunder traffic — targeting by GEO, device, OS, browser, and connection type. CPM and CPC bidding.
- [For Publishers](https://popcash.net/publishers): Monetize with popunder ads. High fill rate, daily payouts, PayPal / Paxum / Payoneer / wire.
- [Traffic Inventory](https://popcash.net/traffic-inventory): Live inventory volume by GEO, device, OS, and browser. Plan media buys with real numbers.

## Support

- [FAQ for Advertisers](https://popcash.net/faq-advertisers): Common questions on account setup, campaign optimization, billing, and targeting.
- [FAQ for Publishers](https://popcash.net/faq-publishers): Onboarding, code integration, payouts, and site approval.
- [Contact](https://popcash.net/contact): Get in touch with the PopCash team.
- [Report Malware](https://popcash.net/report_malware): Report suspicious ad content.

## Company

- [About Us](https://popcash.net/about-us): Company background, team, and history.
- [Blog](https://popcash.net/blog): Ad-tech insights, product updates, and campaign best practices.

## Legal

- [Terms of Service](https://popcash.net/tos): Terms and conditions for using PopCash.
- [Privacy Policy](https://popcash.net/privacy-policy): How PopCash collects, uses, and protects data.

## Key facts

- **Founded**: 2012
- **Ad format**: Popunder (specialist network)
- **Pricing models**: CPM, CPC
- **Coverage**: 240+ GEOs, global inventory
- **Advertiser minimum deposit**: $5
- **Publisher minimum payout**: $10
- **Payout methods**: PayPal, Paxum, Payoneer, wire transfer, and more
- **Sister brand**: [Mondiad](https://mondiad.com) — full-stack ad network (push, native, banner, popunder, and more), founded 2019 by the PopCash team.
